name: Fairness-Aware AI-Generated Face Detection
description: This task involves detecting whether a facial image is real or AI-generated (binary classification) while ensuring fairness across demographic groups defined by skin tone, gender, and age. The task also evaluates robustness under various post-processing conditions and cross-domain scenarios.

cr:input.name: competition_dataset
cr:input.description: The input consists of cropped RGB face images (e.g., 244 × 244 dimensions after preprocessing with RetinaFace). Optional demographic subgroup labels (e.g., Male-Light, Female-Dark) are provided for fairness evaluation.
cr:input.url: [FILL IN THE BLANK: URL to the competition dataset]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: The output includes binary predictions for real/fake classification (0 for real, 1 for fake), along with demographic predictions: skin tone (1-10), gender (0 for Female, 1 for Male), and age group (0-4).

field.name: id
field.description: Unique identifier for the image, e.g., image_001.

field.name: pred
field.description: Prediction for real/fake classification, where 0.0 represents real and 1.0 represents fake.

field.name: skin_tone
field.description: Predicted skin tone on the Monk Skin Tone Scale (1-10).

field.name: gender
field.description: Predicted gender, where 1 represents Male and 0 represents Female.

field.name: age
field.description: Predicted age group, where 0 = Child, 1 = Youth, 2 = Adult, 3 = Middle-age Adult, 4 = Senior.

cr:evaluation.notes: Utility metrics such as AUC, ACC, and AP are higher-is-better, while fairness metrics like FEO, FMEO, FDP, FOAE, and FIND are lower-is-better. Metrics are computed for both raw and post-processed images, and intersectional fairness is assessed across subgroups.
